body.en: When using Grok Build in the terminal to help write code or plan project architecture, running into minor anomalies during tool execution often interrupts your train of thought. ⟦Much like riding a bicycle through city streets, shifting gears used to occasionally run into chain snags or faint metallic scraping noises; now the drivetrain gears mesh tightly, so pedaling forward is no longer interrupted in rhythm by stray minor flaws.⟧ This update specifically resolves the secondary issues encountered during daily operations. In the past, running various commands in the terminal could occasionally hit subtle unexpected errors. These problems have now been smoothly resolved, so subsequent daily operations will no longer be disrupted by stray issues.

title.zh-TW: /resume 支援指定識別碼或標題，啟動恢復時提示詞自動排程送出
title.en: /resume Supports Specifying IDs or Titles, Auto-Queuing Prompts During Session Resumption

body.zh-TW: 想接續先前中斷的工作進度時，終端機現在能更快鎖定歷史紀錄並妥善處理輸入內容。⟦就像向飯店櫃檯調閱住宿名冊，櫃檯人員只要依姓名或編號就能過濾出特定紀錄；即使舊帳本少數頁面破損，櫃檯也會保留備份並搶救出完整資料，不會影響新住客登記。⟧現在輸入 `/resume` 可以加上選填的工作階段識別碼或標題，直接開啟過濾為相符項目的選單。若在啟動並恢復工作階段時送出提示詞，內容會先進入佇列排程，等載入完成後自動送出，不再停留在輸入框。對斜線指令按下立即送出快捷鍵 `Ctrl+Enter`，會依指令形式執行或排入佇列，不再被當成一般提示詞送出。即使工作階段清單損毀，也不會阻止新工作階段登記，Grok 會保留備份、搶救能讀取的資料列，並發出警告提醒你。
body.en: When you want to pick up where you left off, the terminal can now locate historical records faster and handle input more smoothly. ⟦Picture requesting guest logs at a hotel front desk: the clerk filters specific records simply by name or room number; even if a few pages of an old ledger are torn, the desk keeps a backup and recovers all readable data without holding up new guest registrations.⟧ Now, typing `/resume` accepts an optional session ID or title to directly open a menu filtered to matching entries. If you submit a prompt while a session is booting and resuming, the content enters a queue and sends automatically once loading completes, rather than remaining stuck in the input box. Pressing the immediate-send shortcut `Ctrl+Enter` on a slash command now executes or queues it according to command rules, rather than sending it as a plain prompt. Even if the session catalog is corrupted, it will not prevent new sessions from registering, as Grok preserves backups, salvages readable rows, and displays warnings to alert you.

items.original:
`/resume` takes an optional session id or title and opens the picker filtered to matching sessions
Prompts you send while a session is resuming at startup are queued and sent once it loads instead of staying in the composer
A corrupt session list no longer stops new sessions from registering: grok keeps a backup, salvages the rows it can read, and warns you
Send now (`Ctrl+Enter`) on a slash command runs or queues it as a command instead of sending it as a prompt

title.zh-TW: 工作樹分支獨立在專屬路徑執行，終端指令不再誤改原始目錄
title.en: Worktree Branches Run in Dedicated Paths, Preventing Terminal Commands from Modifying Original Directories

body.zh-TW: 當你想在不干擾主要程式碼的情況下嘗試實驗性改動，Git 工作樹（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）能幫你建立獨立分支。⟦如同從原生盆栽剪下枝條移到獨立花盆培育，園丁在分盆修剪或施肥時，修剪動作都不會碰傷原本母株的根葉。⟧現在當你執行 `grok -w -r` 或在對話中輸入 `/fork` 分支出工作樹，終端機不僅會顯示工作樹路徑，所有操作也會切實切換至該路徑下執行。以往在分支出工作樹後執行 Shell 指令，指令往往會誤改到原本的檢出目錄；現在路徑明確切換後，終端機指令不再更動原始目錄。當你為了重構特定模組而分支出工作樹時，可以在獨立路徑下放手執行編譯與修改指令，確保原始專案內容維持原狀。
body.en: When you want to try experimental changes without disrupting primary code, Git worktrees (a feature allowing parallel copies of the same project) help you set up isolated branches. ⟦Think of clipping cuttings from a potted plant to nurture in a separate pot: pruning or fertilizing in the new container never harms the roots or leaves of the parent plant.⟧ Now when you run `grok -w -r` or enter `/fork` in conversation to fork a worktree, the terminal not only displays the worktree path, but also switches all operations directly into that path. In the past, running Shell commands after forking a worktree often accidentally modified the original checkout directory; with explicit path switching now in place, terminal commands no longer touch the original directory. When you fork a worktree to refactor a specific module, you can freely run build and modification commands under the isolated path while keeping your original project untouched.

items.original: Worktree forks (`grok -w -r` or `/fork` into a worktree) run in and show the worktree path, so a shell command no longer edits the original checkout

title.zh-TW: 記憶搜尋顯示長行相符片段，/memory 與技能設定支援符號連結
title.en: Memory Search Displays Snippets for Long Lines, While /memory and Skill Settings Support Symlinks

body.zh-TW: 查閱儲存的記憶紀錄或設定自訂技能時，檔案捷徑與長文字行不再導致檢視中斷。進行記憶搜尋時，若命中內容位於非常長的文字行中，現在會直接顯示包含關鍵字的相符片段，不再於命中位置前就把整行截斷。在終端機輸入 `/memory` 檢視筆記時，若目錄中含有符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），清單會直接略過該筆記，不再使整份清單讀取失敗。在技能設定中，`[skills].ignore` 忽略清單在比對符號連結的 `SKILL.md` 說明檔時，會依存放該檔案的資料夾名稱進行比對。以前只要筆記中夾帶捷徑或關鍵字落在長行末端，查詢便會整份報錯或看不見內文；現在檢索與忽略設定都能精準掌握目標。
body.en: When checking saved memory logs or configuring custom skills, file shortcuts and long text lines no longer disrupt your view. During memory searches, if a match falls inside an extremely long line of text, the terminal now directly displays the matching snippet containing your keyword, rather than truncating the entire line before the hit. When viewing notes by entering `/memory` in the terminal, if a directory contains symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location), the list cleanly skips that note rather than failing to load entirely. In skill configurations, the `[skills].ignore` list matches symlinked `SKILL.md` instruction files against the name of the folder storing the file. Previously, queries would throw errors or hide content whenever notes contained shortcuts or keywords landed at the end of long lines; now both retrieval and ignore settings accurately locate targets.

items.original:
Memory search shows the matching part of a long line instead of cutting it off before the match
`/memory` skips a symlinked note instead of failing the whole listing
`[skills].ignore` matches a symlinked SKILL.md by the folder that holds it

title.zh-TW: 修復終端文字排版與二進位亂碼，支援折行網址與面板點擊
title.en: Fixing Terminal Text Formatting and Binary Garble, with Wrapped URL and Pane Link Clicking Support

body.zh-TW: 在終端機檢視各類輸出與操作卡片時，文字排版與超連結點擊都獲得了細緻修正。貼上帶有 Windows 換行符號的文字時，內容會轉為標準換行送給模型；Markdown 圖片語法不再殘留孤立的驚嘆號，非數學公式的金額符號也會保持純文字。寫入核准卡片若遇到二進位或無法讀取的檔案，會明確標示為無法讀取，不再顯示整片亂碼；檔案讀取失敗時，卡片也能展開顯示具體的失敗原因。執行失敗的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具列，錯誤訊息會依螢幕寬度自動折行並保留原本換行。herdr 面板內的連結現在可以直接點擊；Shell 指令說明中折行的長網址，每一行也都能點開完整連結。以前常因為符號誤判成公式、遇到無法讀取的檔案就跳出亂碼，或是網址斷行而無法點擊；現在介面輸出更為整潔易讀。
body.en: When viewing terminal outputs and action cards, text formatting and hyperlink interactions have received meticulous fixes. Pasting text with Windows line endings now normalizes newlines before sending to the model; Markdown image syntax no longer leaves behind orphaned exclamation marks, and currency signs not intended as math formulas remain plain text. Write approval cards now explicitly mark binary or unreadable files as unreadable instead of rendering screens of garbled characters; if reading a file fails, the card can expand to reveal the specific failure cause. When an MCP (a protocol allowing AI to connect with external tools) tool run fails, the error message wraps to the terminal width while preserving original line breaks. Links inside herdr panes can now be clicked directly; for long URLs wrapped across lines in Shell command help, clicking any line opens the complete link. Previously, symbols were often misread as formulas, unreadable files dumped garbled text, and wrapped URLs broke clickable links; interface output is now noticeably cleaner and easier to read.

items.original:
Pasted Windows line endings reach the model as newlines, markdown images no longer show a stray "!", and dollar amounts that are not math stay plain text
Write approval cards show a binary or unreadable file as unreadable instead of garbled text
Wrapped URLs in shell command descriptions link to the full address on every row
Links are clickable in herdr panes
Failed MCP tool rows wrap the error to the screen width and keep its line breaks
Failed file reads expand to show why they failed

title.zh-TW: 長對話與大段貼上釋放記憶體，閒置處理器耗用與啟動速度最佳化
title.en: Memory Freed in Long Conversations and Large Pastes, with Idle CPU Usage and Startup Speed Optimized

body.zh-TW: 長時間執行對話或貼入龐大資料時，背景資源的佔用情況直接影響操作流暢度。⟦好比圖書館閱覽桌的管理規定，讀者看完的厚重參考書只要推入還書箱便能清出桌面，塗改草稿也不會無止境堆在抽屜裡佔用空間。⟧在長時間運作的工作階段中，當冗長的回覆內容捲出螢幕之外後，Grok 佔用的記憶體會相應減少。在含有大段貼上內容的提示詞中打字反應更快，提示詞的復原歷史紀錄也加上了上限，確保已刪除的貼上內容不再停留在記憶體中。停留在閒置歡迎畫面時的處理器使用率已經降低；若環境變數 `TMUX` 指向已停止運作的 tmux 伺服器，啟動速度也比以往更快。
body.en: During extended sessions or after pasting large amounts of data, background resource usage directly impacts operational smoothness. ⟦Much like library reading desk rules, returning heavy reference books to drop boxes clears the table immediately, and scribbled draft papers never pile up endlessly in drawers to waste space.⟧ In long-running sessions, memory held by Grok decreases as lengthy responses scroll past the screen view. Typing is more responsive in prompts with large pasted blocks, and prompt undo history now has a cap to ensure deleted paste content no longer lingers in memory. CPU utilization while idling on the welcome screen has been reduced; if the `TMUX` environment variable points to a stopped tmux server, startup is also faster than before.

items.original:
Startup is faster when `TMUX` names a tmux server that has stopped
The idle welcome screen uses less CPU
Typing in a prompt that holds large pastes is faster, and prompt undo history is capped so deleted pastes no longer stay in memory
Long sessions use less memory after long replies scroll off screen

title.zh-TW: 長任務與工作流程加強防呆，暫停閒置目標並保護核准按鍵
title.en: Safeguards tighten for long tasks and workflows, pausing idle goals and protecting approval keystrokes

body.zh-TW: 當自動化任務持續運作時，隨意中斷或背景空轉都會打亂排程。⟦正如大樓的自動防護系統，以前隨手切斷開關便會直接終止作業；現在中控台會要求再次確認，防止未完工的流程停擺。⟧結束時若會終止執行中的工作流程，會先提出警告並要求第二次 quit 確認。`/goal` 連續三次繼續執行卻未呼叫工具時會主動暫停，輸入 `/goal resume` 即可接續。若有等待核准的請求，輸入 `/fork` 會被拒絕，確保按鍵繼續回應請求。`/workflow stop` 與 `/workflow pause` 不再以寬鬆模糊比對選取執行個體。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）下以 `-p` 執行時，遭拒的核准請求會印至 stderr。工作流程檢視會列出宣告階段外的代理人，且只將結束者算入 done。
body.en: When automated tasks run continuously, accidental interruptions or background idling can disrupt schedules. ⟦Picture an automated building safety system where flicking a switch previously cut off operations immediately, whereas the control panel now asks for a second confirmation to prevent unfinished routines from stalling.⟧ Exiting when it would terminate an active workflow now raises a warning and requires a second quit confirmation. When `/goal` continues three consecutive times without calling any tools, it automatically pauses, and entering `/goal resume` resumes execution. If approval requests are pending, entering `/fork` is rejected to ensure keystrokes continue responding to prompts. `/workflow stop` and `/workflow pause` no longer pick instances through loose fuzzy matching. Running with `-p` in headless mode (execution without a visual terminal interface) prints rejected approval requests to stderr. The workflow view lists agents outside declaration phases and counts only finished ones toward done.

title.zh-TW: 工作階段清單略過損毀目錄，多視窗寫入完整記錄用量
title.en: Session listings skip corrupted directories, preserving usage across multi-window writes

body.zh-TW: 在多視窗或多終端機環境切換操作時，對話紀錄與執行狀態的保存往往攸關工作延續。以前只要有單一工作階段目錄無法讀取，`grok sessions list` 與 `/resume` 就會整批中斷；現在會自動略過異常資料夾，讓其餘正常紀錄順利列出與接續。當兩個視窗同時寫入同一個工作階段時，每一輪對話的用量紀錄現在都會完整保留，不再相互覆蓋。常駐 shell 即使還原先前狀態失敗，依然會如常執行你輸入的指令。從專案子資料夾建立工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，`grok worktree list` 與 `grok worktree show` 都會正確以儲存庫根目錄為來源回報。
body.en: When switching across multiple windows or terminal environments, preserving conversation logs and execution states is vital for continuity. Previously, if a single session directory was unreadable, `grok sessions list` and `/resume` would abort entirely. They now automatically skip faulty directories, letting remaining valid records list and resume normally. When two windows write to the same session simultaneously, usage records for every turn are now fully preserved instead of overwriting each other. Persistent shells still execute your typed commands as usual even if restoring prior state fails. When creating a worktree (a Git feature that keeps multiple parallel copies of the same project) from a project subfolder, `grok worktree list` and `grok worktree show` correctly report from the repository root.

items.original:
Worktrees created from a repository subfolder report the repository root as their source in `grok worktree list` and `grok worktree show`
Persistent shell runs your command even when restoring its saved state fails
`grok sessions list` and `/resume` keep working when one session directory is unreadable
Session usage keeps every turn when two windows write to the same session

title.zh-TW: 外掛與掛鉤載入異常明朗化，設定檢查會警告非布林值
title.en: Plugin and hook loading errors gain visibility, with config checks warning on non-boolean values

body.zh-TW: 自訂擴充功能或調整環境參數時，清晰的錯誤提示能省下大量摸索時間。現在執行 `/hooks` 會清楚列出行內掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）與外掛載入時發生的錯誤。你手動停用的掛鉤，在記錄停用的檔案無法讀取時依然會保持停用。在 Linux 上安裝外掛時，若 `grok plugin install` 在複製中途被中斷，不再留下殘缺資料夾阻礙重新安裝。當 config.toml 中的已知 `[features]` 鍵值包含非布林值時，`grok inspect` 會發出警告。輸入 `/docs` 會直接開啟你鍵入的精確指南或挑選器。單純執行 `grok --help` 與 `grok --version` 時，不會再自動建立 `.grok` 資料夾。
body.en: Clear error diagnostics save substantial troubleshooting time when customizing extensions or adjusting environment parameters. Running `/hooks` now clearly lists errors encountered while loading inline hooks (small programs triggered when a specific event occurs) and plugins. Hooks you manually disable remain disabled even if the file recording disabled entries cannot be read. When installing plugins on Linux, interrupting `grok plugin install` mid-copy no longer leaves corrupted folders that block reinstallation. When known `[features]` keys in config.toml contain non-boolean values, `grok inspect` issues a warning. Entering `/docs` directly opens your exact typed guide or picker. Simply running `grok --help` and `grok --version` no longer automatically creates a `.grok` folder.

items.original:
`/hooks` lists load errors from inline hooks and from plugins
`grok --help` and `grok --version` no longer create a `.grok` folder
`grok plugin install` interrupted mid-clone on Linux no longer leaves a partial folder that blocks the retry
Hooks you disabled stay disabled when the disabled-hooks file cannot be read
`/docs` opens the exact guide or picker you type
`grok inspect` warns when a known `[features]` key in config.toml has a non-boolean value

title.zh-TW: 終端機指令折行自動整併，黑白環境以增減號標記差異
title.en: Wrapped terminal commands join automatically, with monochrome diffs marking changes using plus and minus signs

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中檢視長輸出與比對程式碼時，排版細節直接影響操作的流暢度。⟦好比在多欄排版的收據上複製長序號，以前只要號碼被折到下一行，手動剪下就得自己刪除多餘換行；現在選取折行內容會自動連成完整文字，一貼就能直接使用。⟧工具與背景任務列中折行顯示的 shell 指令，複製時會自動還原為單行文字。工具標頭中折行的網址，現在每一行都能點擊連向完整地址。同時編輯多個檔案時，會明確標註本次編輯還改動了多少其他檔案。當關閉色彩顯示時，編輯差異比對會以 `-` 與 `+` 標記刪除與新增行。讀取目錄清單失敗時，清單會自動展開顯示失敗原因。
body.en: Layout details directly shape workflow smoothness when reviewing long terminal output and comparing code. ⟦Think of copying a long serial number from a multi-column receipt, where wrapped lines previously required manually deleting stray breaks after cutting, whereas selecting wrapped text now automatically joins into continuous text ready to paste directly.⟧ Shell commands displayed across wrapped lines in tool and background task rows automatically restore to a single line when copied. Wrapped URLs in tool headers can now be clicked on any line to navigate to the complete address. When editing multiple files simultaneously, the view explicitly notes how many other files this edit touches. When color output is disabled, edit diffs mark deleted and added lines with `-` and `+`. If reading a directory listing fails, the list automatically expands to show the reason for failure.

items.original:
Wrapped shell commands in tool and background-task rows copy back as one line
Multi-file edits show how many other files the edit changed
Wrapped URLs in tool headers link to the full address on every row
Edit diffs mark removed and added lines with `-` and `+` when color is off
Failed directory listings expand to show why they failed

title.zh-TW: 輸入焦點與反饋草稿加強防護，快捷送出避開背景卡片
title.en: Input focus and feedback drafts gain protections, with instant submissions bypassing background cards

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入回覆或反饋時，最怕突如其來的提示視窗搶走游標焦點。⟦跟在郵局櫃檯填單一樣，以前只要後方號碼牌一響或專員遞件，手上的表格就會被收走；現在檯面保留你的書寫空間，讓你從容寫完手頭內容。⟧在輸入 `/feedback` 時，即使中途收到權限請求、提問或外部工具提示，反饋視窗依然會維持開啟。讀取反饋草稿時，即便有單一草稿損毀，其餘有效草稿仍會正常載入。輸入 `@` 提及檔案時，會重複使用暫存的檔案清單，直到資料夾結構改變才重新掃描，讓候選建議更快出現。嘗試編輯排隊中的指令（例如 `/compact`）時會跳出提示並拒絕操作，完整保留你剛鍵入的新文字。按 `Ctrl+Enter` 立即送出時，不再會誤回答停止子代理人面板或外部工具提示卡片。
body.en: When typing responses or feedback in the terminal, sudden popups stealing cursor focus are especially disruptive. ⟦Like filling out forms at a post office counter where a chiming ticket or an arriving clerk previously whisked away your paperwork, the desk now reserves your writing space so you can finish the task at hand unhurriedly.⟧ When entering `/feedback`, the feedback window stays open even if permission prompts, questions, or external tool notices arrive in the background. When loading feedback drafts, remaining valid drafts still load normally even if a single draft is corrupted. Typing `@` to mention files reuses a cached file list until directory structures change before rescanning, making suggestions appear faster. Attempting to edit a queued command (such as `/compact`) displays a prompt and rejects the action, fully preserving your newly typed text. Pressing `Ctrl+Enter` to submit immediately no longer accidentally answers stop subagent panels or external tool prompt cards.

items.original:
`/feedback` stays open while you type when a permission request, question, or MCP prompt arrives
`/feedback` Drafts load the valid drafts when one saved draft is invalid
Editing a queued command such as `/compact` is refused with a message, so your new text is kept
Send now (`Ctrl+Enter`) no longer answers the stop-subagents panel or an MCP prompt card
@-mentions reuse the file list until the folder tree changes, so suggestions appear faster

title.zh-TW: 外部工具支援平行輸入提示，啟動旗標落實互動介面權限
title.en: External tools support parallel input prompts, with launch flags enforcing interactive terminal permissions

body.zh-TW: 透過外接工具擴充 AI 的操作能力時，精準的權限範圍與清晰的互動提示格外關鍵。啟動時設定的 `--tools` 與 `--disallowed-tools` 工具名單，現在於互動式終端介面中也會生效。當模型透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）平行呼叫多個需要輸入的工具時，各呼叫會分別顯示自己的提示。設定標準輸入輸出形式的 Stdio MCP 伺服器時，指令與參數開頭的波浪號 `~` 會被展開。`~` 現在會自動展開成你的家目錄，不必手打絕對路徑；平行呼叫各自顯示自己的提示卡片。
body.en: Expanding AI capabilities through external tools demands precise permission boundaries and clear interactive prompts. The `--tools` and `--disallowed-tools` lists configured at launch now take effect inside the interactive terminal interface as well. When models make parallel calls through MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) to multiple tools requiring input, each call displays its own prompt. When configuring stdio MCP servers, a leading tilde `~` in commands and arguments is expanded. `~` now automatically expands into your home directory without manually typing absolute paths, and parallel calls display their own distinct prompt cards.

items.original:
`--tools` and `--disallowed-tools` also apply in the interactive TUI
Parallel MCP tool calls that ask for input each show their own prompt
Stdio MCP servers expand a leading `~` in their command and arguments to your home directory

title.zh-TW: 終端機支援 Rex，長對話折疊與排版更俐落
title.en: Terminal Supports Rex, Bringing Cleaner Folding and Layout to Long Chats

body.zh-TW: 平日盯著終端機跟 AI 密切協作時，最怕畫面捲動卡頓或排版突然亂掉。⟦好似在翻閱排版精緻的雜誌，內文欄位整齊對齊邊界，折頁隨手一撥就能俐落展開，不再被折痕切斷字句。⟧現在程式正式支援 Rex 終端機與 OSC 7501 控制序列。終端機裡的工具呼叫群組在有新操作加入時會持續維持展開，長對話中按下 `Ctrl+E` 展開或收折思考過程也更加迅速。如果提示詞或引號裡的超連結因為文字過長而折行，點擊時依然能正確連向完整網址。模型回覆裡的行內標籤不會再破壞版面排版。在工作階段內用來恢復舊工作階段的選單，若設定為不分組，現在會跟歡迎畫面的不分組排版一致。
body.en: Working closely with AI in the terminal, nothing is more frustrating than scrolling stutter or suddenly scrambled formatting. ⟦Picture flipping through a beautifully formatted magazine, where columns align neatly against margins and foldout pages expand smoothly at a touch without creasing through lines of text.⟧ The application now officially supports the Rex terminal and OSC 7501 control sequences. Tool call groups inside the terminal stay expanded when new operations are added, and pressing `Ctrl+E` during long conversations expands or collapses thinking processes much faster. When hyperlinks inside prompts or quotations wrap across lines due to length, clicking them still reliably opens the complete URL. Inline tags within model responses will no longer disrupt layout alignment. In addition, the in-session menu for resuming earlier sessions, when set to ungrouped, now mirrors the ungrouped layout on the welcome screen.

title.zh-TW: 子目錄可載入專案掛鉤，狀態列掌握當前回合資訊
title.en: Subdirectories Load Project Hooks, and Status Line Tracks Turn Details

body.zh-TW: 替專案撰寫自動化擴充時，不同目錄的自訂規則現在能精準到位。⟦宛如大樓各樓層的專屬警衛室，進駐該樓層就能啟動當地的巡邏規章，線路故障時當場亮起警示，值班看板也隨時顯示當前任務的接單序號。⟧如果你在儲存庫的子資料夾啟動 grok，該子目錄下的專案掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在會正確載入。連往本機 localhost 的 HTTP 掛鉤也能正常運作，若網址填寫錯誤，載入時就會立刻報錯。終端機底部的指令狀態列（statusLine，終端機最底部的即時資訊列）腳本在回合執行期間，也能順利取得當前回合的提示詞識別碼與開始時間。
body.en: When writing automated extensions for a project, custom rules across different directories now apply with precision. ⟦Think of dedicated guard stations on each building floor, where checking into a floor activates local patrol protocols, wiring faults trigger on-the-spot warnings, and duty boards constantly display order sequence numbers for active tasks.⟧ If you launch grok from a subdirectory of a repository, project hooks under that subdirectory will now load correctly. HTTP hooks connecting to local localhost also operate properly, immediately raising an error during loading if a URL is incorrect. Furthermore, command statusLine scripts at the bottom of the terminal can smoothly retrieve the prompt ID and start time of the current turn while the turn runs.

items.original:

Command status-line scripts see the current turn prompt ID and start time while the turn is active

title.zh-TW: 模型切換重啟不回彈，思考力度參數嚴格校驗
title.en: Model Switches Persist Across Restarts, with Strict Validation for Effort Flags

body.zh-TW: 當你想換個更合適的模型解題時，設定結果現在會老實保存。⟦如同替專業相機切換拍攝模式，轉盤卡住時不會擅自改寫自訂選單，重新開機依然停在最後選定的檔位，調整進階參數時若鏡頭不支援也會亮燈提醒。⟧以前使用 `/model` 切換模型若中途失敗，頁尾顯示和儲存的預設模型仍會被改掉，現在切換失敗會維持原狀。切換成功後重新啟動 grok，也不會再倒退回先前的舊模型。如果你使用 `grok -p --effort` 指定思考力度，程式會直接拒絕無效的力度數值；若目前使用的模型忽略這項參數，也會明確發出警告。
body.en: When switching to a more suitable model to solve a problem, your configuration is now reliably preserved. ⟦Much like switching shooting modes on a professional camera, a jammed dial never silently overwrites custom menus, rebooting preserves the last selected gear, and adjusting advanced parameters illuminates a warning light whenever the lens lacks support.⟧ Previously, if switching models via `/model` failed mid-operation, the footer display and saved default model were still overwritten; now, a failed switch leaves the existing state intact. After a successful switch, restarting grok no longer reverts to the previous model. If you use `grok -p --effort` to specify reasoning effort, the program directly rejects invalid effort values, and it explicitly issues a warning if the active model ignores this parameter.

items.original:
`/model` switches that fail no longer change the footer or the saved default model
`grok -p --effort` warns when the model ignores the flag, and refuses invalid effort levels
Restarting after a model switch no longer reverts to the previous model

title.zh-TW: 檔案匯出拒絕覆寫，大圖拒收與搜尋失敗清楚報錯
title.en: File Exports Block Overwrites, with Clear Errors for Large Images and Failed Searches

body.zh-TW: 整理對話紀錄或搜尋專案內容時，操作遇到阻礙不再默默失敗。使用匯出或複製功能時，若目標檔案已經存在，程式會主動拒絕覆寫並顯示清楚的提示訊息，避免原有內容被蓋掉。在終端機貼上超過 50 MB 的超大圖片時，畫面會跳出明確訊息拒絕接收，不再無聲把圖片吃掉。當工具執行 `grep` 搜尋或使用 `list_dir` 列出資料夾時，若遇到搜尋逾時、執行失敗或目錄無法讀取，現在會明確回報錯誤，不再假裝查無資料而回傳空白。以前遇到這些狀況只能自己瞎猜到底有沒有送出或到底查完了沒，現在每一處阻礙都有清楚說明。
body.en: When organizing conversation logs or searching project contents, blocked operations no longer fail silently. When using export or copy features, if the destination file already exists, the program proactively refuses to overwrite it and displays a clear prompt to keep existing content intact. Pasting an oversized image exceeding 50 MB into the terminal triggers an explicit rejection message instead of silently swallowing the file. When tools execute a `grep` search or use `list_dir` to list folders, any search timeout, execution failure, or unreadable directory now explicitly reports an error instead of returning blank output as if nothing was found. Where you previously had to guess whether an operation was dispatched or finished, every obstacle now comes with clear feedback.

items.original:
Export and copy refuse to overwrite an existing file, and show a clear message
Pasted images over 50 MB are rejected with a clear message instead of being dropped silently
`grep` and `list_dir` report a clear error when a search times out or fails, or the folder cannot be read, instead of returning no results

title.zh-TW: 離開乾淨終止背景指令，取消操作清楚標明對象
title.en: Exiting Cleanly Halts Background Commands, and Cancellations Identify Targets

body.zh-TW: 當你決定按下中斷鍵或退出程式，手邊正在跑的任務現在會乾淨收尾。⟦就像舞台監督透過對講機喊卡，所有燈光與後台機關立刻同步停機，場記板明確記下喊停的幕次，不再發生演員散場而機關還在後台空轉的窘境。⟧以前退出 grok 或發送中斷訊號後，部分背景指令仍會私下繼續佔用資源，現在結束時會老實終止所有由它啟動的子行程。在終端機按下取消時，畫面也會清楚印出究竟是哪一道指令被停止。如果你使用 `/workflow stop` 停止工作流程，程式也能精準鎖定當前真正處於執行中的任務，不會誤停其他進程。
body.en: When you hit the interrupt key or exit the program, active tasks now wrap up cleanly. ⟦A stage manager calls cut over the intercom: stage lights and backstage machinery immediately power down in unison, the clapperboard logs the halted scene, and machinery never idles backstage after the cast departs.⟧ Previously, after quitting grok or sending an interrupt signal, certain background commands continued consuming resources behind the scenes; now, exiting faithfully terminates all child processes spawned by the session. When you trigger a cancellation in the terminal, the screen explicitly displays which command was stopped. If you use `/workflow stop` to halt a workflow, the program accurately targets tasks currently running without mistakenly terminating other processes.

items.original:
Shell commands no longer keep running after you quit grok, or after grok receives a signal
Cancelled terminal commands show the command that was stopped
`/workflow stop` picks the correct live run

title.zh-TW: 審核卡片不再突然消失，授權通知明確指名工作階段
title.en: Review Cards Persist Reliably, and Authorization Prompts Specify Sessions

body.zh-TW: 放手讓 AI 在背景處理複雜任務時，需要你點頭授權的關鍵卡片不再跟你玩捉迷藏。⟦好比總經理桌上的急件待辦夾，各部門送上來的簽呈會蓋妥所屬專案的章戳，送達時自動移開桌面上的大型看圖板，即便主幹部的會議散會，底下助理未簽核的請款單依然好好留在桌前。⟧背景子代理（subagent，負責分工處理特定子任務的代理程式）送出的審核卡片，在父回合結束時不會再無故消失。跳出的審核通知現在會明確標示是哪一個工作階段需要你批准。在極簡模式下如果權限提示與隱藏的計畫或取消面板同時出現，畫面會確實呈現該權限提示。每當審核卡片浮現，程式也會自動關閉區塊檢視器，避免卡片內容遭到遮擋。
body.en: When leaving AI to handle complex tasks in the background, the key approval cards requiring your sign-off will no longer play hide-and-seek. ⟦Consider an executive's urgent pending folder, where incoming petitions from each department are stamped with their respective project marks, large drafting boards slide aside upon arrival, and pending requisitions remain securely on the desk even after the leadership meeting adjourns.⟧ Review cards submitted by background subagents no longer vanish without reason when a parent turn ends. Pop-up authorization notifications now explicitly indicate which session requires your approval. In minimal mode, if a permission prompt coincides with a hidden plan or cancel panel, the screen reliably renders the permission prompt. Whenever a review card appears, the program also automatically closes the block viewer to prevent card content from being obscured.

items.original:
Approval cards for background subagents no longer disappear when the parent turn ends
Approval notifications name the session that needs approval
Minimal mode shows the permission prompt instead of a hidden plan or cancel panel when both are present
Approval cards close the block viewer so the card is visible

title.zh-TW: 工作樹刪除設下嚴格防線，使用中與外部目錄一律拒刪
title.en: Worktree Deletion Enforces Safeguards, Blocking Active and External Folders

body.zh-TW: 清理專案的多重副本時，重要程式碼與進行中的作業現在有更嚴密的保護。⟦恰如租車公司的還車清點機制，只要車輛仍有登記中的租約在路上行駛，就不允許註銷車籍；若開來的不是自家出租的車輛或整間調度場的總鑰匙，也會立刻拒絕受理。⟧使用工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，執行 `grok worktree rm` 或 `gc` 垃圾回收清理，若發現有開啟中的工作階段正使用該副本，指令會直接拒絕刪除。`grok worktree rm` 也設下了嚴格的安全防線，一律拒絕刪除任何 Git 儲存庫、`.git` 資料夾或任何非 grok 自行建立的目錄，不再因為手滑誤打指令而釀成災難。
body.en: When cleaning up multiple project copies, essential code and active work receive tighter safeguards. ⟦Rental car return inspections enforce a strict checklist: vehicles with active leases on the road cannot be deregistered, and returning an outside vehicle or a master lot key is turned away on the spot.⟧ When managing worktrees, running `grok worktree rm` or `gc` garbage collection cleanup will directly refuse deletion if an active session is currently using that copy. `grok worktree rm` also erects strict safety boundaries, flatly refusing to remove any Git repository, `.git` directory, or any folder not created by grok itself, preventing mistyped commands from causing disaster.

title.zh-TW: 脈絡溢位觸發自動精簡，對話過長不再當機或循環
title.en: Context Overflow Triggers Compaction, Ending Crashes and Loops in Long Chats

body.zh-TW: 跟 AI 進行長篇對話或調用大量工具時，記憶空間被塞爆的窘境現在有了自動排解機制。⟦彷彿隨行秘書在會議記錄爆量時主動整理精華提要，騰出筆記本空間讓會議繼續進行，若連續重抄三次重點依然爆頁，也會老實停筆確認，不再盲目撕頁重寫。⟧如果工具回合內容過長且包含工具使用後的自訂掛鉤輸出，程式會主動壓縮摘要，不再直接撞上提示詞長度上限。當遇上脈絡溢位（context overflow，對話總長度超出模型單次能處理的容量）錯誤時，程式會自動觸發壓縮，不再讓當前回合直接當掉。為了避免無休止的壓縮消耗資源，自動壓縮只要連續三次填滿脈絡就會主動停下，不再陷入死迴圈。
body.en: During lengthy conversations with AI or extensive tool usage, the frustration of exhausted memory space now has an automatic resolution mechanism. ⟦An executive secretary condenses key highlights as meeting minutes swell, freeing notebook space so discussions proceed, and pauses to verify after overflowing pages three times in a row rather than tearing out sheets blindly.⟧ If a tool turn runs overly long and includes custom post-tool hook output, the program proactively summarizes and compacts the content instead of colliding with prompt length limits. When a context overflow error occurs, the program automatically triggers compaction rather than letting the current turn crash. To prevent runaway compaction from consuming resources, automatic compaction pauses after filling the context three consecutive times, preventing infinite loops.

items.original:
Long tool turns that include PostToolUse hook output compact instead of hitting the prompt length limit
Context overflow errors trigger automatic compaction instead of failing the turn
Auto-compaction stops after three context refills in a row instead of looping

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式自動濾除 BOM，MCP 工具遇無效字元不再逾時
title.en: Headless Mode Filters BOMs, and MCP Tools Avoid Timeouts on Invalid Characters

body.zh-TW: 利用自動化腳本批次餵入提示詞或串接外部服務時，隱形字元造成的離奇錯誤現在已徹底排除。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）下，如果提示詞檔案開頭帶有微軟檔案常見的 BOM 位元組順序記號，程式會主動濾除，不再把多餘標記送給模型，也不會弄壞 JSON 提示詞檔。當外部工具透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）回傳結果時，即便內容夾雜無效字元，也不會再導致工具呼叫逾時卡死。以前這些肉眼看不到的編碼符號常在暗處作怪，讓排程任務莫名中斷或卡在等待畫面，現在這類字元解析問題已經修好。⟦就像自動驗票機讀取票卡，以前表面只要沾了看不見的殘膠或夾帶污漬就會卡死閘門，現在能主動濾除干擾順利放行。⟧
body.en: When feeding prompt batches via automation scripts or connecting external services, bizarre errors caused by invisible characters are now eliminated. In headless mode, if a prompt file starts with a BOM byte-order mark common to Microsoft files, the program proactively strips it away, preventing extraneous markers from reaching the model or corrupting JSON prompt files. When external tools return results over MCP, invalid characters in the payload will no longer trigger tool call timeouts or freezes. Where invisible encoding symbols previously caused subtle bugs that abruptly halted scheduled tasks or left processes hanging, character parsing issues of this kind are now resolved. ⟦Automated ticket gates scan transit cards: where invisible adhesive residue or stray smudges once jammed the turnstile, the sensor now filters out surface noise to let passengers through smoothly.⟧

items.original:
Headless prompts that start with a byte-order mark no longer send that mark to the model, and no longer break JSON prompt files
MCP tool replies that contain invalid characters no longer cause the call to time out

body.zh-TW:
想用腳本在背景批次跑完專案目標時，你不再需要盲目猜測任務究竟有沒有順利收尾。

⟦走進投幣式洗衣店洗衣服，以前按下開關後你不知道衣服洗好了沒，現在螢幕會確實等到脫水完成才跳出收據；按下暫停鍵會止水，中途打開機門重新關上也能繼續運轉。⟧

在 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）下執行 `grok -p` 時，程式會等待背景目標徹底完成並回報最終成果。若加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數，超過時限就會主動中止目標，結束時也不會再誤印多餘的暫停訊息。

When running `grok -p` in headless mode (execution without a terminal window), the process waits for background goals to fully finish and reports the final outcome. title.zh-TW: 大容量提示詞自動轉存檔案，圖片拖曳與長貼上不中斷

貼上極長的問題與提示詞時，系統會自動轉存為獨立檔案傳送，不再擠在對話字串中發送。在未支援括號貼上標記的終端機環境中，長文字也不會再卡在約 1 KB 的長度，而是能完整讀取。

你現在可以直接從檔案管理員把圖片拖曳進終端機視窗作為附件。若隨同 `/pr-workflow` 等擴充技能指令貼上圖片，圖片會如實送給模型處理；來自外部工具的圖片也會先完成格式驗證，即使拿到損毀檔案也不會導致對話中斷，且寫入大型檔案或截取多張畫面時，工作階段都能維持正常運作。
body.en:
When pasting massive code blocks or screenshots into prompts, input channels no longer freeze the interface from data overload.

⟦Much like shipping an oversized parcel through the post office, overweight mail is automatically boxed and diverted to freight instead of bouncing or jamming mail slots, and attaching fragile stickers no longer tears packages.⟧

When pasting exceptionally long questions or prompts, the system offloads them into separate files for delivery instead of cramming them into conversation strings. In terminal environments lacking bracketed paste support, long text no longer stalls around 1 KB and reads through completely.

You can now drag and drop images directly from file managers into terminal windows as attachments. Pasting images alongside skill commands like `/pr-workflow` delivers the images faithfully to the model. Images from external tools undergo format verification so corrupted files do not crash the session, which continues running smoothly even when writing large files or capturing multiple screenshots.

Images from tools are validated so a bad file no longer breaks the turn
Dragging images from a file manager onto a terminal attaches them

Large file writes or many screenshots no longer end the session

title.zh-TW: 終端機快捷鍵與對話框翻新，搜尋捲動與多選操作更順手

在啟用擴充按鍵的 tmux（終端機多工器，可在單一視窗切割面板的工具）中，`Shift+Enter`、`Ctrl+.`、`Ctrl+/` 與 `Ctrl+[` / `]` 已能辨識。瀏覽 `/feedback` 草稿時，按 `G`、`Home` 或 `End` 即可跳到首筆或末筆。

面對多選題提問，送出前可用數字鍵切換多個選項。`/find` 搜尋在串流輸出時依然精確計算比對次數，並捲動到含結果的折行處。

對話框開啟時按 `Ctrl+C` 依然能取消回合。在高度較窄的終端機中，`/feedback` 等對話框能維持可讀性，傳送失敗狀態也會在對話框內折行。
body.en:
When navigating menus inside cramped terminal windows, key responsiveness and screen layout become significantly smoother.

⟦Operating a folding toolbox in a cramped workshop feels much smoother when organizers scale to fit overhead clearance, top and bottom drawers can be reached directly, and pulling the power switch instantly cuts electricity.⟧

In tmux (a terminal multiplexer that splits windows into panes) with extended keys enabled, `Shift+Enter`, `Ctrl+.`, `Ctrl+/`, and `Ctrl+[` / `]` are now recognized. When browsing `/feedback` drafts, pressing `G`, `Home`, or `End` jumps directly to the first or last entry.

For multi-select questions, number keys toggle multiple choices before submitting. Running `/find` continues counting matches accurately during streaming output and scrolls directly to wrapped lines containing results.

Pressing `Ctrl+C` while dialogs are open still cancels the turn. In terminals with limited vertical height, dialogs such as `/feedback` preserve readability, and delivery failure states wrap cleanly within the dialog box.

title.zh-TW: 儀表板工作階段釘選持久保留，路徑支援引號與刪除防呆
title.en: Dashboard session pins persist across restarts, supporting quoted paths and safe deletions

body.zh-TW:

⟦恰似辦公室牆上的磁吸公告板，以前下班關燈後標籤順序容易被打亂、撤下的舊單子還黏在角落，現在釘選的常用便箋重開機後依然整齊歸位，撕下作廢單據也不會留下殘膠。⟧

在 dashboard（儀表板，統一管理所有對話任務的總覽面板）中釘選的工作階段，現在會嚴格維持當初釘選的順序，即使重開程式也不會跑掉。關閉工作階段後，該項目會確實清除，不再殘留在未啟用清單中。

在詳細資訊檢視中輸入 `/exit`，只會單獨關閉當前檢視的工作階段。使用 Peek 快速預覽時，透過上下鍵移動焦點後再按數字鍵，不會再錯誤指派到非預期的代理程式。

執行 `/cd` 或使用位置選擇器時，現在允許路徑包含引號或跳脫字元。輸入 `/delete` 指令時若後方接有多餘字串，會直接回報錯誤，不再誤將目前的工作階段直接刪除。
body.en:
When frequently inspecting and switching between multiple project sessions, panel ordering and operational safeguards are far more dependable.

⟦Imagine a magnetic bulletin board on an office wall: pinned routine notices return neatly to their original spots after rebooting instead of scrambling when lights go out, and discarded slips leave no sticky residue behind when torn away.⟧

Pinned sessions in the dashboard (an overview panel managing all conversation tasks) now strictly preserve their original pinning order even after restarting. Closing a session clears the item completely instead of leaving it stranded in the inactive list.

Entering `/exit` from the detail view closes only the currently viewed session. During Peek previews, moving focus with arrow keys before pressing number keys no longer assigns tasks to unintended agents.

Executing `/cd` or using the location picker now permits paths containing quotes or escaped characters. Entering `/delete` with trailing characters returns an immediate error instead of accidentally deleting the active session.

`/cd` and the location picker accept quoted or escaped folder paths
`/delete` with extra text shows an error instead of deleting the current session

Closing a session in the dashboard no longer leaves it listed under Inactive

⟦正像在建築事務所修改設計圖，以前重寫上一道草稿，桌面上做好的模型就會被推倒重來，現在重新遞交只更新圖紙，砌好的磚牆完好無損。⟧

在長工作階段中取消並重新編輯送出訊息時，不再會錯誤還原工作區的檔案。登出時會立即中斷本機工作階段正在執行的輪次。

登入失敗時會提供清楚的下一步指引，不再直接丟出原始錯誤。若 `grok -p` 尚未儲存登入憑證，會自動執行設定的認證命令（`auth_provider_command`）。

開啟工作階段時若未能取得模型清單，會自動切換為 Auto 模型。對空白工作階段執行 `/compact`（壓縮對話紀錄以騰出容量的指令）時，也不再重設回報的上下文視窗數值。
body.en:
When repeatedly refining requirements throughout long conversations, code files and account states receive more comprehensive protection.

⟦Revising blueprints at an architectural firm no longer knocks over finished models on the desk when rewriting an earlier draft, because resubmissions update only the drawings while freshly laid brick walls remain intact.⟧

Canceling and re-editing submitted messages during long sessions no longer mistakenly reverts files in the workspace. Logging out immediately halts active turns in local sessions.

Login failures provide clear next steps instead of dumping raw errors. If `grok -p` has no saved login credentials, it automatically executes the configured authentication command (`auth_provider_command`).

Opening a session falls back to the Auto model when failing to retrieve the model list. Running `/compact` (a command condensing conversation history to free space) on an empty session also no longer resets reported context window values.

`grok -p` runs `auth_provider_command` when no login is stored
Sessions that open without a model list use Auto
Sign-in failures show a clear next step instead of a raw error

title.zh-TW: 建立平行工作副本更穩定，Git 模式保留未提交修改
title.en: Stabilizing Parallel Working Copies with Git Mode Preserving Uncommitted Changes

body.zh-TW:
當你想要在不打擾現有進度的情況下另開分支嘗試新想法，這正是啟用工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）的時機。

⟦跟在廚房另闢備用料理檯一樣，以前移動做到一半的菜容易弄丟備料甚至卡住，現在以 Git 模式換到新工作檯能保留未提交修改，擺設兩張料理桌也不會互相打架。⟧

使用 `-w` 以 Git 模式建立工作樹時，現在能保留當前未提交的修改，並相容採用獨立 git 目錄的儲存庫；在非 Git 儲存庫或空的 Git 儲存庫中執行會顯示清楚錯誤。

使用 `--worktree-ref` 參數建立的副本，不會再誤塞錯誤的子模組內容或 LFS 指標純文字。

若同時以相同標籤發起兩次建立，兩個副本都會順利完成，不再跳出已存在的錯誤；建立失敗時，首頁與各路徑也會統一印出明確原因。
body.en:
When you want to branch off to try new ideas without disrupting ongoing work, it is the perfect time to use worktrees (a Git feature that lets you run multiple parallel copies of the same project).

⟦Picture setting up a spare prep counter in a kitchen: moving half-finished dishes used to risk misplacing ingredients or getting stuck, but switching to a new counter in Git mode preserves uncommitted changes, and having two prep tables will not cause them to clash.⟧

When creating a worktree in Git mode using `-w`, it now preserves current uncommitted changes and is compatible with repositories that use separate git directories. Running it in a non-Git repository or an empty Git repository now displays a clear error.

Copies created with the `--worktree-ref` flag will no longer mistakenly include incorrect submodule content or raw LFS pointer text.

If you launch two creations simultaneously with the same label, both copies will complete smoothly without throwing an already-exists error. When creation fails, the home page and all paths also consistently print a clear reason.

Two worktree creates with the same label at the same time both succeed, instead of one failing with "already exists"

title.zh-TW: 移除工作樹嚴格把關，避免誤刪同名檔案
title.en: Strict Safeguards for Removing Worktrees to Avoid Accidental Deletion of Same-Named Files

body.zh-TW:
整理專案而準備清理用不到的分支副本時，最怕指令一敲下去就連帶抹除尚未存檔的心血。

⟦像清理公用置物櫃一樣，以前只要號碼牌相近就可能整箱清空，現在只要櫃內還有私人物品或在其他樓層有同名置物櫃，管理員就會直接停手拒絕清空。⟧

執行 `grok worktree rm` 刪除工作樹時，若未加上 `-f` 強制參數，只要該工作樹正在使用或有未儲存的變更，指令會立即報錯並拒絕刪除；它也不會誤刪只是碰巧同名的其他無關資料夾。

透過標籤指定刪除時，若發現該標籤同時存在於多個儲存庫，指令會主動拒絕執行以防刪錯對象。

執行 `/fork --worktree` 指令後，終端機回報的圖片與日誌路徑現在都會確實指向本機的真實檔案。
body.en:
When organizing a project and preparing to clean up unused branch copies, the biggest fear is running a command that wipes out unsaved work.

⟦Think of cleaning out shared lockers: previously, similar locker numbers could cause the entire box to be cleared, but now, as long as personal belongings remain inside or another locker shares the same name on a different floor, the attendant will stop immediately and refuse to clear it.⟧

When running `grok worktree rm` to delete a worktree without adding the `-f` force flag, the command immediately reports an error and refuses deletion if that worktree is in use or has unsaved changes. It also will not accidentally delete other unrelated folders that merely happen to share the same name.

When specifying deletion by label, if that label exists across multiple repositories simultaneously, the command actively refuses execution to prevent deleting the wrong target.

After running the `/fork --worktree` command, the image and log paths reported by the terminal now reliably point to real local files.

body.zh-TW:
在終端機處理專案檔案時，最擔憂磁碟或路徑異常導致既有檔案被清空或改錯。

寫入檔案若發生失敗，現在會完整保留原本的舊內容，不再留下一片空白的空檔案。使用 `grok --cwd a` 切換目錄時，指令會穩穩停在 `a` 目錄內，不會莫名跑進重複巢狀的 `a/a` 中執行。

在介面中執行放棄檔案變更時，只會還原你親自勾選的檔案，絕不牽連名稱相近的其他檔案。

當工作階段的工作目錄在外部被刪除或不存在時，輸入提示詞會立刻以清楚訊息回報失敗，不再延遲報錯或自行重新建立該工作目錄；即使工作區目錄遺失或工具輸出量極為龐大，終端機工具呼叫也不會失敗或溢位。

以前遇到目錄被搬動或寫入中斷，容易留下空白檔案或動到名稱相近的檔案，現在各項檔案操作都有了明確的停損與保護機制。
body.en:
When working with project files in the terminal, the greatest concern is disk or path anomalies wiping out or corrupting existing files.

If writing to a file fails, it now completely preserves the original content instead of leaving behind a blank, empty file. When switching directories with `grok --cwd a`, the command stays securely inside directory `a` rather than mysteriously running inside a duplicated, nested `a/a`.

When discarding file changes in the interface, it only reverts the files you explicitly checked, never affecting other files with similar names.

When a session's working directory is deleted externally or does not exist, entering a prompt immediately reports failure with a clear message, rather than delaying errors or recreating that working directory on its own. Terminal tool calls will neither fail nor overflow even if the workspace directory is missing or the tool output volume is massive.

Previously, moved directories or interrupted writes easily left blank files or touched similarly named files; now, every file operation comes with explicit stop-loss and protection mechanisms.

items.original:
A failed file write leaves the previous contents in place instead of an empty file
`grok --cwd a` stays in `a` instead of running inside `a/a`
CLI tool calls no longer fail or overflow when the workspace directory is gone or the output is huge
A prompt fails immediately, with a clear message, when the session working directory is gone, instead of failing later or recreating it
Discard changes only the files you select, not similarly named files

title.zh-TW: 頂部點選複製分支全名，儀表板完整顯示工作樹
title.en: Click Top Header to Copy Full Branch Names as Dashboard Fully Displays Worktrees

body.zh-TW:
當你需要把正在開發的分支名稱傳給同事或填入發行紀錄，直接在介面上點選就能省去手動打指令查詢的時間。

⟦彷彿把展示標籤換成了磁吸條，窄視窗中顯示縮寫保持版面整齊，輕輕一點仍能帶走完整的原始名稱。⟧

點選頂部標頭的 Git 分支名稱即可直接複製完整分支名字；就算在狹窄的終端機視窗裡，長分支名會自動縮寫呈現，但點擊後依然能複製出全名。

儀表板現在會標示每個工作階段所屬的工作樹，並在建立新代理人的輸入框中顯示所選的 `-m` 模型，並允許在資料夾選取器內自由切換工作樹模式。

遇到 Git 合併或改基時發生的檔案衝突，也會直接列在變更清單中，方便一眼掌握哪些檔案需要排除衝突。
body.en:
When you need to send an active branch name to a colleague or paste it into release notes, clicking directly in the interface saves the time of manually querying it via commands.

⟦A display tag has been swapped for a magnetic strip: narrow windows display abbreviations to keep the layout tidy, yet a single click still picks up the complete original name.⟧

Clicking the Git branch name in the top header directly copies the full branch name. Even in narrow terminal windows, long branch names are automatically abbreviated, but clicking still copies the entire name.

The dashboard now indicates the worktree to which each session belongs, displays the selected `-m` model in the input box for creating new agents, and allows freely toggling worktree mode within the folder picker.

File conflicts encountered during Git merges or rebases are also listed directly in the changes list, making it easy to see at a glance which files require conflict resolution.

items.original:
Clicking the git branch in the header copies the full branch name
Long branch names abbreviate on narrow terminals and stay copyable
The dashboard shows which worktree each session belongs to, shows the `-m` model in the new-agent box, and lets you toggle worktree mode in the folder picker
Merge and rebase conflicts show up in the changes list

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式收合停靠區，關閉分頁不誤送排隊指令
title.en: Compact Mode Collapses Dock Without Sending Queued Prompts on Tab Close

body.zh-TW:
想在有限的終端機螢幕空間裡專注於當前對話，切換到精簡模式能幫你迅速騰出視野。

⟦比照折疊式工作桌的收納邏輯，以前在長型螢幕上收合側欄容易破壞內部間距，現在收起停靠區時不僅畫面維持清爽留白，快捷鍵呼叫各項抽屜功能也依然順暢無阻。⟧

精簡模式現在會將摘要資訊自動收合，並在較高的終端機視窗中維持合理的內部留白；它也會主動隱藏停靠區或任務面板，效果與手動按下 `Ctrl+G` 鍵完全一致。

當你使用 `Ctrl+G` 隱藏停靠區時，排隊面板與呼叫排隊項目的 `Ctrl+;` 快捷鍵依然能正常彈出與操作。

按下 `Ctrl+P` 開啟的命令面板與模型選擇器，寬度調整為與設定視窗一致；關閉正在執行任務的分頁後，不再把排隊中的提示詞送給模型。
body.en:
If you want to focus on the current conversation within limited terminal screen space, switching to compact mode quickly frees up your view.

⟦Following the storage logic of a folding desk: collapsing the sidebar on tall screens previously broke internal spacing, but tucking away the dock now keeps the screen cleanly spaced, and shortcut keys calling drawer functions remain completely unobstructed.⟧

Compact mode now automatically collapses summary information and maintains reasonable internal padding in taller terminal windows. It also actively hides the dock or task panel, matching the exact effect of manually pressing `Ctrl+G`.

When you use `Ctrl+G` to hide the dock, the queue panel and the `Ctrl+;` shortcut that summons queued items continue to pop up and operate normally.

The command palette and model selector opened with `Ctrl+P` have been adjusted to match the width of the settings window. After closing a tab that is executing a task, queued prompts are no longer sent to the model.

items.original:
Compact mode collapses recaps and keeps inner spacing on tall terminals
Compact mode hides the dock, or the tasks pane, the same way `Ctrl+G` does
The command palette (`Ctrl+P`) and the model picker open at the same width as the settings modal
The queue pane and `Ctrl+;` still appear and work when the dock is hidden with `Ctrl+G`
Closing a busy tab no longer sends its queued prompts to the model

title.zh-TW: 表格支援直接匯出格式，即時預覽掌握伺服器狀態
title.en: Export Formats Supported for Tables with Live Previews Tracking Server Status

body.zh-TW:
當模型在終端機裡整理出大量比對資料時，你不再需要用滑鼠吃力地框選文字再手動貼入試算表。

輸出的表格現在附帶專屬複製按鈕，能直接匯出為 TSV、CSV 或 Markdown 格式，方便直接貼進 Excel 或各類試算表軟體。

在即時預覽釘選項目中，現在會清楚標明該網址背後是否確實偵測到運作中的應用程式。

時間戳記功能現在支援透過設定介面或輸入 `/timestamps` 指令調整，提供關閉、極簡與開啟三種顯示模式。

在 `/usage` 與 `/session-info` 視窗中，過長的錯誤訊息會自動折行顯示而不再被視窗邊界切斷；狀態訊息與子代理人列表也移除了多餘的破折號符號，整體視覺更為俐落。

以前複製終端機表格總要花時間重新分欄，長訊息也經常被視窗切字，現在各項輸出都能直接對接日常工具並完整呈現。
body.en:
When the model organizes large comparison datasets in the terminal, you no longer need to struggle with mouse selections before manually pasting into a spreadsheet.

Exported tables now include dedicated copy buttons to export directly in TSV, CSV, or Markdown format, making it easy to paste straight into Excel or various spreadsheet applications.

Pinned live preview items now clearly indicate whether a running application is actually detected behind the URL.

The timestamp feature can now be adjusted via the settings interface or by running `/timestamps`, offering three display modes: off, minimal, and on.

In the `/usage` and `/session-info` windows, excessively long error messages wrap automatically instead of being cut off by window borders. Redundant dash symbols have also been removed from status messages and subagent lists, producing a cleaner visual layout.

Previously, copying terminal tables required time to re-split columns, and long messages were frequently clipped by windows; now, every output integrates directly with daily tools and renders completely.

items.original:
A timestamps setting offers off, minimal, and on in Settings and `/timestamps`
Live preview pins include whether an app was observed behind the URL
Tables show copy buttons that export TSV, CSV, or Markdown for spreadsheets
Long error messages in the `/usage` and `/session-info` modals wrap instead of being cut off
Status messages and subagent rows no longer use em dashes

title.zh-TW: 歷程摘要無需捲動直接看，斜線指令不拘大小寫
title.en: View History Summaries Without Scrolling as Slash Commands Accept Mixed Case

body.zh-TW:
隨著對話輪次增加而觸發背景整理時，你現在一眼就能看清當前專案對話的精簡摘要。

⟦恰似調校好的提詞機一樣，以前濃縮的摘要文字容易被推到螢幕下方的視覺死角，現在整理完成的關鍵訊息會滾動到看得見的位置，輸入控制指令時也不會因為按錯大寫鍵而失效。⟧

對話總結摘要現在開箱就能直接在螢幕上完整可見，不需手動捲動捲軸；若該輪有壓縮訊息，回合結束後會捲動到看得見的位置，不再隱沒在視窗底部之外。

斜線指令完全相容大小寫字母，無論輸入 `/COMPACT` 或 `/Compact` 都能正常執行。

輸入 `/context` 檢視上下文時，介面不再擅自顯示代理人沒有回報的自動壓縮門檻；當輸出說明文字中途觸發工具呼叫時，終端機停止無謂重繪分頁器。
body.en:
When conversation turns accumulate and trigger background compaction, you can now see the condensed summary of the active project conversation at a single glance.

⟦Much like a calibrated teleprompter, where condensed summary text was once pushed into blind spots below the screen, compiled key messages now scroll into visible view, and control commands will not fail from an accidental Caps Lock.⟧

Conversation summaries are now fully visible on screen out of the box without requiring manual scrolling. If a turn includes compacted messages, it scrolls into a visible position once the turn ends, rather than remaining hidden below the window bottom.

Slash commands are fully case-insensitive, executing normally whether you type `/COMPACT` or `/Compact`.

When running `/context` to view context, the interface no longer displays auto-compaction thresholds that the agent never reported. When tool calls are triggered mid-explanation, the terminal stops needlessly redrawing the pager.

items.original:
Recap summaries show up on screen without scrolling
Slash commands run in any case, such as `/COMPACT` or `/Compact`
`/context` no longer shows an auto-compact threshold the agent did not report
Agent text stops redrawing the pager when a tool call interrupts the sentence
Compaction messages scroll into view instead of sitting below the bottom of the screen after a turn

title.zh-TW: 診斷工具精準點名故障設定，意見回饋真實反映送出結果
title.en: Diagnostics Accurately Pinpoint Faulty Configurations as Feedback Faithfully Reports Delivery Status

body.zh-TW:
當環境設定異常導致工具無法正常開啟時，精確的自我診斷能幫你省下反覆翻查設定檔的痛苦。

執行 `grok doctor` 健檢指令時，工具現在會指出阻礙啟動的設定檔或設定項目，不再盲目回報零異常。

執行 `grok doctor fix` 自動修復指令時，確認視窗的焦點預設停在「取消」按鈕，避免使用者手快按錯而意外更動了現有的 shell 或 tmux 設定檔。

如果工作流程檔案解析出錯，錯誤報告會明確列出該檔案名稱與詳細的解析錯誤訊息，不再只留下一句含糊的「未知工作流程」。

模型在背景儲存的草稿，在 `/feedback` 視窗中會如實顯示真正的標題；送出回饋時也會精確回報傳送成功或失敗，不再過早顯示感謝提示或重複堆疊前綴字詞。

以前遇到設定衝突只能靠猜測除錯，現在從啟動檢測到回饋提交都具備清晰透明的狀態回饋。
body.en:
When environmental configuration issues prevent tools from starting normally, precise self-diagnosis spares you the pain of repeatedly scouring configuration files.

When running the `grok doctor` health check command, the tool now pinpoints the configuration files or settings obstructing startup, instead of blindly reporting zero anomalies.

When running the `grok doctor fix` auto-repair command, the confirmation dialog defaults focus to the Cancel button, preventing users from accidentally modifying existing shell or tmux configuration files due to quick keystrokes.

If a workflow file fails to parse, the error report explicitly lists the filename and detailed parse error message, instead of leaving behind a vague "unknown workflow".

Drafts saved by the model in the background now faithfully display their actual titles in the `/feedback` window. Submitting feedback also accurately reports delivery success or failure, without prematurely displaying thank-you prompts or stacking duplicate prefixes.

Previously, resolving configuration conflicts meant guessing and debugging; now, clear and transparent status feedback accompanies everything from startup checks to feedback submissions.

items.original:
Drafts the model saves show up under their real titles in `/feedback`
A workflow file that fails to parse reports that file and the parse error, instead of "unknown workflow"
Feedback submissions report success or failure accurately, without an early thanks or a repeated prefix
`grok doctor` names the config file or setting that prevents Grok from starting, instead of reporting zero issues
`grok doctor fix` opens its confirmation on Cancel, so it does not edit shell or tmux config by accident

title.zh-TW: 定向中斷指定回覆，取消任務正確標記工具狀態
title.en: Targeted Interruption for Specific Responses While Marking Cancelled Tool States Correctly

body.zh-TW:
當多個任務同時在終端機背景推進，你中途發現某個方向有誤時，需要精確叫停而不能波及其他正常運作的程序。

⟦猶如工廠產線上裝設的獨立煞車鈕，以前按下拉桿容易讓整排設備全部停擺，現在只會針對指定的工作台煞車，並確實把未做完的工序蓋上作廢印記而非合格章。⟧

發出定向取消請求時，現在只會精準停止客戶端指名中止的那一次回覆，不影響其他正在進行的工作。

在被中途取消的對話輪次裡，尚未取得回應的工具呼叫會正確記錄為已取消，不會再被錯誤判定為執行成功。

選擇讓程式繼續執行時，背景子代理人內部正在跑的指令會安穩保留，不會被無故中斷；按下 `Ctrl+\` 或帶有修飾鍵的數字時，也不會再誤觸權限面板或取消確認卡上的按鈕。
body.en:
When multiple tasks advance concurrently in the background and you spot an error in one direction, you need to halt it precisely without disturbing other operating processes.

⟦Like an independent emergency brake on a factory assembly line: pulling the lever previously risked halting entire rows of equipment, but now it brakes only the designated station and properly stamps unfinished processes as voided rather than approved.⟧

When issuing a targeted cancellation request, it now halts only the specific response explicitly designated by the client, without affecting other ongoing work.

In conversation turns cancelled midway through, tool calls that have not yet received responses are properly recorded as cancelled, rather than erroneously marked as successful.

When choosing to let the program continue running, commands running inside background subagents are safely preserved without unintended interruption. Pressing `Ctrl+\` or numbers with modifier keys also no longer triggers buttons on permission panels or cancellation confirmation cards.

items.original:
A targeted cancel stops only the response the client asked to stop
Cancelled turns mark unanswered tool calls as cancelled instead of succeeded
Continue to run no longer kills commands that are running inside background subagents
`Ctrl+\` and other modified digits no longer select an option on a permission or cancel card

title.zh-TW: 權限規則容錯升級，原生工具名稱直接納管
title.en: Permission Rules Gain Fault Tolerance with Native Tool Names Managed Directly

body.zh-TW:
替命令列工具設定存取白名單時，設定檔的一點筆誤不該讓整道防護機制整組失效。

權限規則現在直接支援 `run_terminal_command` 與 `Shell` 等原生工具名稱，讓控管規則能直接對齊底層工具呼叫；當終端機指令符合權限管理員所設定的規則時，終端機會如實提示確認或直接放行。

託管的權限設定檔即使包含個別錯誤鍵值，其餘正確的規則依然會正常載入與生效；某個區段裡若有一條規則語法不正確，也不會再導致該區塊內的其他規則整批失效。

搜尋工具 `grep` 現在會嚴格遵守開頭帶有 `./` 相對路徑的讀取拒絕規則。

以前只要設定檔裡敲錯一個字，所有放行與防護名單就會集體停擺，現在具備了獨立容錯能力，日常安全控管更加穩健。
body.en:
When setting up access allowlists for command-line tools, a minor typo in a configuration file should not bring down the entire protection mechanism.

Permission rules now directly support native tool names such as `run_terminal_command` and `Shell`, allowing control rules to align directly with underlying tool calls. When a terminal command matches rules set by the permission manager, the terminal faithfully prompts for confirmation or grants direct access.

Even if a managed permission configuration file contains isolated invalid keys, remaining valid rules still load and take effect normally. An invalid syntax rule within a section will no longer invalidate all other rules across that block.

The `grep` search tool now strictly honors read denial rules that start with `./` relative paths.

Previously, a single typo in a configuration file could paralyze every allowlist and safeguard; with standalone fault tolerance now in place, day-to-day security controls are far more dependable.

items.original:
Shell permission decisions prompt or approve commands that match the permission manager
Permission rules accept native tool names such as `run_terminal_command` and `Shell`
A managed permission file with one bad key keeps its valid rules
One bad permission-rule entry no longer drops the other rules in that section
`grep` respects Read deny rules that use a leading `./`

title.zh-TW: 逾 4MB 工作階段持續連線，串流中斷自動重試
title.en: Sessions Over 4MB Stay Connected, Stream Drops Automatically Retry

body.zh-TW:
當你與模型進行深度的多輪架構探討時，最怕對話累積過長導致連線無故中斷或只吐出半截答案。

⟦就拿長途電話的自動重撥機制來說，以前只要通話時間太長或線路延遲就會被硬生生切斷，現在遇到串流無故中斷會自動重新接通，不同程式重試時也會主動錯開等待秒數防止撞車。⟧

對話內容即使超過 4 MiB，超長的工作階段依然能穩定維持連線；如果模型呼叫中途停滯，在該回合判定失敗前會先自動重試。

Chat Completions 串流若在沒有附帶結束原因的情況下突然斷線，會自動重試而非直接留下殘缺片段；各行程的重試等待間隔會各自錯開。

請求封包大小現在會確實遵守 `max_request_bytes` 所設定的上限；直接輸入 `/model` 切換模型時，思考力度會維持你先前的設定，不再擅自跳回新模型的預設力度。
body.en:
When you have in-depth, multi-turn architecture discussions with a model, the biggest worry is that conversations grow too long, causing connections to drop without warning or return incomplete answers.

⟦In a long-distance phone system with auto-redial, calls used to get abruptly severed whenever conversations ran too long or lines lagged, but now dropped streams reconnect automatically while retries from different processes stagger their wait times to prevent collisions.⟧

Even when conversation content exceeds 4 MiB, ultra-long sessions maintain a stable connection; if a model call stalls halfway through, it retries automatically before marking the turn as failed.

If a Chat Completions stream disconnects abruptly without a finish reason, it automatically retries instead of leaving incomplete fragments behind; retry backoff intervals are jittered across processes.

Request payload sizes now strictly observe the limit configured in `max_request_bytes`; switching models directly with `/model` preserves your previously configured reasoning effort instead of reverting to the new model's default.

items.original:
A stalled model call during a turn retries before the turn fails
Long sessions stay connected when the conversation is larger than 4 MiB
Request bodies stay under a configured `max_request_bytes` limit
The effort level stays the same after a bare `/model` switch, instead of jumping to the new model default
Chat Completions streams that end without a finish reason are retried instead of returning partial output
Retry waits differ between processes

title.zh-TW: 回滾游標精準停在句尾，排程支援中文時間間隔
title.en: Rewind Cursor Lands Accurately at Prompt End, Scheduler Supports Chinese Time Intervals

body.zh-TW:
當你需要撤回剛才的提問並稍作微調時，回滾指令能讓你迅速回到上一輪對話。

⟦像是把卡帶倒帶機換上了數位書籤，以前回捲後游標容易停錯位置，現在不僅游標貼心停在提示詞最末端方便接著打字，設定定時巡檢也能直接輸入中文時間。⟧

執行 `/rewind` 指令復原歷史紀錄時，輸入游標現在會精確定位在還原後的提示詞結尾，能直接按倒退鍵或接著補充內容；在開啟持久回滾檢查點功能的環境下，建立新工作階段也不會再莫名當機。

循環指令 `/loop` 與排程工具 `scheduler_create` 現在直接支援非英文字元的時間間隔，例如輸入 `5分` 即可正確建立週期任務，不再引發工作階段崩潰。

若在啟動參數 `--disallowed-tools` 中禁用了某個特定的排程工具，其餘未被禁用的排程工具在開機時依然能正常載入與啟動。
body.en:
When you need to undo your previous question and make minor adjustments, the rewind command quickly returns you to the earlier turn.

⟦Upgrading a tape rewinder with digital bookmarks illustrates this behavior: rewind used to leave the cursor in the wrong position, but now the cursor rests conveniently at the very end of the restored prompt for immediate typing, and scheduled checks accept intervals in Chinese.⟧

When running `/rewind` to restore conversation history, the input cursor lands precisely at the end of the restored prompt, letting you backspace immediately or continue adding text; creating new sessions with persistent rewind checkpoints enabled also no longer crashes unexpectedly.

The `/loop` command and the `scheduler_create` tool now directly support non-English time intervals, such as entering `5分` to create recurring tasks without crashing the session.

Disabling a specific scheduler tool through the `--disallowed-tools` startup flag still allows all remaining enabled scheduler tools to load and start normally during launch.

items.original:
`/rewind` places the text cursor at the end of the restored prompt
`/loop` and `scheduler_create` accept non-ASCII intervals such as `5分` without crashing the session
Naming only one scheduler tool in `--disallowed-tools` no longer makes the other two fail startup
Starting a new session with durable rewind checkpoints on no longer crashes

title.zh-TW: 終端機清楚呈現執行狀態，無頭模式支援管道輸入
title.en: Terminal Clearly Shows Execution Status, Headless Mode Supports Piped Input

body.zh-TW:
把任務放到背景執行或用腳本串接時，最需要清楚的狀態提示與安靜的輸入管道。

終端機指令執行時會顯示「Running …」，結束顯示「Ran …」；若背景工作階段正等待核准，視窗標題會標註「Action Required」方便即時處理。

在無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）下執行 `grok` 時，能直接從管道傳入的標準輸入讀取提示詞，不再嘗試開啟互動介面。

在 `requirements.toml` 設定 `[features] title_refresh = false`，即使有 `GROK_TITLE_REFRESH` 也會停用標題更新；管理員若釘選 `[cli] use_leader = false`，帶有 `--leader` 旗標也不會啟動主導行程。

以前背景任務常不知卡在哪，現在狀態一目了然，腳本處理也更安靜穩定。
body.en:
When running tasks in the background or piping them into scripts, clear status indications and quiet input streams are essential.

Terminal commands display "Running …" while executing and "Ran …" when finished; if a background session is waiting for approval, the window title displays "Action Required" for prompt handling.

When running `grok` in headless mode (operating without a terminal window), it reads prompts directly from piped standard input without attempting to launch an interactive interface.

Setting `[features] title_refresh = false` in `requirements.toml` disables title refreshes even when `GROK_TITLE_REFRESH` is present; pinning `[cli] use_leader = false` as an administrator prevents starting a leader process even if the `--leader` flag is passed.

Background tasks previously left users unsure where work stalled, but status is now immediately clear and script processing is quieter and more reliable.

items.original:
Shell command output shows "Running …" while a command executes and "Ran …" when it finishes
The terminal title shows "Action Required" when any background session is waiting on approval
Headless `grok` accepts a prompt on piped stdin instead of trying to open the UI
`[features] title_refresh = false` in `requirements.toml` disables title refresh even when `GROK_TITLE_REFRESH` is set
An admin pin of `[cli] use_leader = false` keeps `--leader` from starting a leader process

title.zh-TW: 設定檔支援多視窗並行寫入，通知掛鉤記憶體受控
title.en: Config Supports Concurrent Multi-Window Writes, Notification Hooks Control Memory Usage

body.zh-TW:
當你開了多個終端機視窗各自調整偏好時，最怕兩邊一齊存檔導致全域設定互相覆蓋損毀。

現在多個視窗同時修改偏好設定時，不會再遺失或損壞 `config.toml` 內的權限清單或 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器設定。

在 `[[ui.notifications.hooks]]` 區塊下自訂的通知掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），遇到符合的事件時會如實執行指定的命令。

即使執行的命令掛鉤印出極為龐大的輸出文字，也不會再導致記憶體用量異常飆高。

輸出至檔案的日誌內容，或在啟用 `NO_COLOR` 變數的環境中，文字皆會維持乾淨純文字格式，避免摻雜難以閱讀的顏色控制碼。

以前多視窗同時編輯設定容易把檔案改爛，掛鉤輸出量一大，記憶體也會飆高，現在底層寫入與日誌處理都更加穩妥。
body.en:
When you open multiple terminal windows to adjust preferences, saving simultaneously risks overwriting and corrupting global settings.

When multiple windows modify settings simultaneously, permissions lists and MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server settings in `config.toml` are no longer lost or corrupted.

Custom notification hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) configured under `[[ui.notifications.hooks]]` faithfully execute their specified commands upon matching events.

Even when executed command hooks print massive output text, memory usage no longer spikes abnormally.

Log output written to files, or environments where the `NO_COLOR` variable is active, keeps text in a clean plain-text format, preventing hard-to-read ANSI color codes from leaking in.

Editing preferences across multiple windows previously risked corrupting files, and high hook output caused memory spikes, but underlying file writes and log handling are now far more reliable.

items.original:
Custom notification commands under `[[ui.notifications.hooks]]` run when their events match
Grok windows editing settings at the same time no longer drop or corrupt `config.toml` entries such as MCP servers or permission rules
Logs written to a file, or written when `NO_COLOR` is set, are plain text
Command hooks no longer spike memory when they print a lot of output

title.zh-TW: 工具搜尋支援同名伺服器，記憶庫檢索相容中日韓
title.en: Tool Search Supports Same-Named Servers, Memory Retrieval Compatible with CJK

body.zh-TW:
當你為代理人掛載多個外部服務與知識庫時，精準的工具查找與記憶讀取是維持流暢運作的關鍵。

當多個 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器提供名稱相同的工具時，執行 `search_tool` 現在會完整列出所有相符工具，不再丟失任何一個伺服器的選項。

網頁擷取工具 `web_fetch` 在將龐大檔案載入記憶體前就會主動拒絕下載，避免耗盡記憶體資源。

記憶庫讀取工具 `memory_get` 會嚴格把關檔案大小，不再回傳超出上限的超長檔案；而檢索工具 `memory_search` 現在能精準在長篇筆記中比對中文、日文與韓文字詞。

以前掛載多個伺服器容易漏掉同名功能，查詢中文筆記也時常撲空，現在工具探索完整且能妥善防範大檔案塞爆記憶體。
body.en:
When attaching multiple external services and knowledge bases to an agent, accurate tool discovery and memory retrieval are critical for smooth operation.

When multiple MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers offer tools with identical names, running `search_tool` lists all matching tools without dropping options from any server.

The `web_fetch` tool proactively declines downloads before loading oversized files into memory, preventing memory exhaustion.

The `memory_get` tool strictly enforces file size limits, no longer returning oversized files that exceed thresholds; the `memory_search` tool now accurately matches Chinese, Japanese, and Korean words across lengthy notes.

Attaching multiple servers previously risked missing identically named tools, and querying Chinese notes often came up empty, but tool discovery is now thorough and large files are properly prevented from overflowing memory.

items.original:
When several MCP servers expose a tool with the same name, `search_tool` returns all of them
`web_fetch` rejects a huge file before downloading it into memory
`memory_get` no longer returns a file that exceeds the read limit
`memory_search` finds Japanese, Chinese, and Korean words inside longer notes

title.zh-TW: 圖片生成拒絕無效檔案，保留透明通道與拍攝方向
title.en: Image Generation Rejects Invalid Files, Preserves Transparency and Camera Orientation

body.zh-TW:
當你請模型生成創意圖片或處理相簿照片時，最怕拿到的圖檔方向顛倒或是漂亮的去背圖案走樣。

⟦正像專業沖印店處理相片一樣，以前轉檔容易把透明背景洗成整塊死黑、直向自拍洗成橫向躺平，現在重新編碼不僅完全依循拍攝方向標籤轉正，遇到損壞的假圖檔也會在第一時間拒收。⟧

呼叫繪圖功能時，如果模型回傳的內容並非有效圖檔，繪圖工具會主動拒絕處理，不會再硬生生將無效資料存成 `.jpg` 檔。

重新編碼圖片時，轉檔程式會自動讀取並保留 EXIF 標籤所記錄的旋轉方向，讓直拍照片維持正常站立方向。

含有透明背景的圖檔重新轉檔後會繼續維持 PNG 格式，透明部分不會變成一片漆黑。
body.en:
When asking a model to generate creative illustrations or process photo albums, inverted image orientations or broken transparency cutouts can ruin the result.

⟦Professional photo labs inspect and process prints with similar rigor: format conversions previously turned transparent backgrounds solid black and flattened portrait selfies sideways, but re-encoding now rotates images upright using orientation tags and promptly rejects corrupted fake files.⟧

When invoking image generation, if the model returns content that is not a valid image file, the tool proactively rejects it instead of forcibly saving invalid data as a `.jpg` file.

When re-encoding images, the conversion routine automatically reads and preserves rotation orientation recorded in EXIF tags, keeping portrait photos upright.

Images with transparent backgrounds remain in PNG format after re-encoding, preventing transparent areas from turning solid black.

items.original:
Imagine replies that are not valid images are rejected instead of being saved as `.jpg` files
Re-encoded images keep the orientation from their EXIF tags
Transparent images stay PNG when they are re-encoded, instead of turning black

title.zh-TW: 終端機保留縮排定位字元，內建 ripgrep 隨時可用
title.en: Terminal Preserves Indentation Tabs, Bundled ripgrep Ready for Immediate Use

body.zh-TW:
讓模型在終端機執行指令分析程式碼時，排版縮排與高效搜尋是決定除錯精確度的關鍵。

⟦宛若為工程師配備了專屬高精度量尺與高速探測器，以前回傳輸出時縮排常被抹平變形，現在不僅程式碼定位字元完整保留，即使在最簡陋的容器環境裡也能隨時呼叫全文搜尋引擎。⟧

終端機指令印出的輸出內容中，所包含的 Tab 定位字元在傳送給模型閱讀時會原汁原味保留，不再被擅自抹去或破壞對齊。

工具內建打包的 `ripgrep` 高速搜尋工具，現在直接開放給終端機環境的所有指令呼叫，即便是在沒有額外安裝該工具的精簡容器映像檔內也能直接使用。

終端機工具說明已清楚寫明真實的輸出截斷長度上限；檔案搜尋工具 `grep` 也會切實依循當前工作階段目錄的相對通配規則進行比對。
body.en:
When having models run terminal commands to analyze code, formatting indentation and efficient search determine debugging accuracy.

⟦Giving engineers a dedicated precision gauge and high-speed detector reflects this upgrade: returned output previously flattened indentation, but tab characters are now preserved in full and a full-text search engine can be called at any time even in minimal containers.⟧

Tab characters contained in terminal command output are now preserved intact when passed to the model, rather than being stripped away or breaking alignment.

The bundled `ripgrep` search utility is now directly accessible to all commands in the terminal environment, making it immediately usable even inside minimal container images without extra installations.

Terminal tool documentation now clearly states the true output truncation limit; the file search tool `grep` also strictly honors relative globbing patterns from the current session directory.

items.original:
Tab characters in terminal command output are kept when the output is shown to the model
The bundled ripgrep is available to terminal commands, even on images that do not install it
Shell tool descriptions state the real output truncation limit, and `grep` respects globs relative to the session directory

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤確認納入所有模式，聯網與生圖先對照提示政策
title.en: Hook confirmations now cover all modes, while web search and image generation check prompt policy first

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 Grok 處理任務時，它何時會停下來請你確認授權，現在有了更明確的規矩。⟦就像社區櫃檯處理快遞與訪客，以前每次有人按電鈴都直接打電話吵你，現在會先對照住戶登記的收件規約，只有未授權的特殊狀況才會撥電話請示。⟧現在進行網路搜尋、網頁抓取與圖片生成等操作時，在跳出提示詢問你之前，會先遵循 `prompt_policy` 設定與既有的規則判定。對於掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），其權限提示現在於每一種核准模式下都會如實出現，確保自動化腳本在各種環境中都能正常跳出確認。
body.en: When you have Grok handle tasks, the rules for when it pauses to ask for your authorization are now clearer. ⟦Think of a community front desk managing deliveries and visitors: previously, staff phoned to disturb you every time someone rang the bell, but now they check registered delivery rules first and only call for instructions during unauthorized exceptions.⟧ When performing operations such as web searches, web scraping, and image generation, Grok now follows your `prompt_policy` settings and existing rule evaluations before popping up a prompt to ask you. For hooks (scripts triggered when specific events occur), permission prompts now appear reliably under every approval mode, ensuring that automated scripts prompt for confirmation properly across all environments.

items.original:
Hook permission prompts appear in every approval mode
Web searches, fetches, and image generation follow the `prompt_policy` setting and rule decisions before they prompt

title.zh-TW: 單次放行限下一條指令，終止行程提前阻擋誤殺外覆程式
title.en: One-time approvals apply only to the next command, while process termination blocks accidental kills of shell wrappers

body.zh-TW: 當你在提示畫面上放行指令時，每一次批准能管轄的範圍現在界定得更精確。⟦如同在管制區領用單次通行證，以前核准一次容易讓後面的車輛跟著開過，現在每張證件只放行緊接著的那一輛車；若是發現工程名單包含管制崗哨本身，更會在動手前提早攔截。⟧現在當你在權限卡片上點選「允許一次」（Allow once），這項放行僅嚴格套用到下一條 shell 指令，後續指令不會被順道放行。而執行 `pkill -f` 與 `pgrep -f` 這類搜尋或終止行程的指令時，如果指定的比對條件會殺死包裝 Grok 自身的 shell 外覆程式（shell wrapper），現在會提早被拒絕執行，避免終端機環境意外中斷。
body.en: When you approve commands on the prompt screen, the scope governed by each approval is now defined more precisely. ⟦Picture using a single-entry permit in a restricted area: previously, approving one permit could easily let trailing vehicles drive through behind it, but now each pass releases only the vehicle immediately following; if a project list happens to include the guard post itself, the operation is intercepted early before work begins.⟧ Now, when you select 'Allow once' on a permission card, this release strictly applies only to the next shell command, and subsequent commands are not passed along with it. When running commands like `pkill -f` and `pgrep -f` to search for or terminate processes, if the specified matching pattern would kill the shell wrapper enclosing Grok itself, execution is now rejected early to prevent accidental terminal disruptions.

items.original:
Allow once on a permission card applies only to the next shell command
`pkill -f` and `pgrep -f` are rejected earlier when the pattern would kill their own shell wrapper

title.zh-TW: /rewind 倒轉對話時只列出你親手輸入的指令
title.en: /rewind only lists prompts you typed when rewinding conversations

body.zh-TW: 當你請 AI 寫程式寫到一半想推翻重來、想跳回先前的步驟時，終端機裡的歷史清單現在不會再被雜訊淹沒。⟦好比翻閱會議紀錄時，以前每一頁中間都夾雜設備檢查與換電池的雜記，現在只保留與會者真正說過的話，讓你一眼就能翻回想重來的那一刻。⟧以前打 `/rewind`（倒轉對話的指令）準備挑選要退回的時間點，清單裡常會混雜系統在背景自動產生的過渡紀錄。現在這項指令只會列出你親手敲進去的提示詞（prompt，向 AI 發出的指令），自動產生的執行輪次通通直接跳過。
body.en: When you want to scrap code changes halfway through and jump back to a previous step while pairing with AI, the history list in your terminal is no longer flooded with noise. ⟦Think of flipping through meeting minutes: in the past, every page was cluttered with notes on equipment checks and battery swaps, but now only words attendees actually spoke remain, letting you spot the exact moment you want to revisit at a glance.⟧ Previously, running `/rewind` to select a rollback point often displayed a list mixed with intermediate records that the system generated automatically in the background. title.zh-TW: config.toml 設定自訂模型時保留原始公告橫幅
title.en: config.toml preserves original notice banners when configuring custom models

body.zh-TW: 如果你在專案設定檔裡切換或掛載自己慣用的模型，現在終端機依然能完整看見官方的重要提示。在 `config.toml`（管理設定選項的檔案）中設定自訂模型表格時，有時需要指定不同的模型來源。以前只要填入這些自訂內容，終端機原本會顯示的公告橫幅（notice banner，說明模型條款或使用須知的提示區塊）就會莫名失蹤。現在無論你怎麼自訂模型表格，原始公告都會安然保留在畫面上。⟦如同改裝車輛儀表板時，以前換上自選配件會把原廠的警示標籤蓋掉，現在換了儀表之後，關鍵的原廠提醒依然老老實實貼在上方。⟧
body.en: If you switch to or mount preferred models in your project configuration file, your terminal still displays official notices in full. When configuring a custom model table in `config.toml`, you sometimes need to specify different model sources. Previously, filling in these custom details caused the terminal's notice banner to mysteriously disappear. Now, no matter how you customize the model table, the original announcement remains safely on screen. ⟦Picture modifying a vehicle dashboard: previously, swapping in aftermarket accessories covered up factory warning labels, but now key manufacturer reminders stay firmly in place after changing the instruments.⟧

items.original: Custom model tables in `config.toml` keep the original model notice banner

title.zh-TW: 檔案讀取、搜尋與替換工具更能應對超大與特殊檔案
title.en: File reading, search, and replacement tools better handle oversized and special files

body.zh-TW: 請 AI 幫忙翻找或修改程式碼時，最怕遇到專案裡夾雜非純文字檔案導致工具直接卡死。現在 `read_file`、`search_replace` 與 `grep` 遇到特殊檔案（例如系統管道或裝置捷徑）時更為穩定。面對超大檔案或二進位內容（binary content，非一般純文字的圖檔或編譯檔）時，也不容易突然當掉。就算真的無法讀取，工具也會直接給出清楚具體的錯誤訊息，不再丟出令人困惑的故障代碼。⟦彷彿圖書館的掃描機升級了感應器，以前塞進厚重字典或夾著相片的冊子會直接卡紙死機，現在不僅能順暢處理，遇到真的無法判讀的裝訂也會清楚顯示原因。⟧
body.en: When asking AI to search or modify code, the biggest fear is running into non-plain-text files in a project that freeze tools completely. Now, `read_file`, `search_replace`, and `grep` are significantly more stable when encountering special files such as system pipes or device links. When facing oversized files or binary content, they are also far less likely to crash unexpectedly. Even if a file cannot be read, the tools now provide clear, specific error messages instead of throwing confusing failure codes. ⟦A library scanner upgrades its sensors: previously, feeding in a thick dictionary or a booklet with photos caused paper jams and system crashes, but now it processes them smoothly and clearly shows the reason whenever a binding truly cannot be scanned.⟧

items.original: `read_file`, `search_replace`, and `grep` handle large files, special files, and binary content more reliably, and surface clearer errors

title.zh-TW: 工具呼叫更守規矩，取消單一操作不影響其他平行指令
title.en: Tool calls follow rules more reliably, and canceling a single operation leaves other parallel commands unaffected

body.zh-TW: 放手讓 AI 查詢網路或同時執行多個動作時，你對背後工具的掌控度現在變得更加穩固。⟦就像派幾位助理分頭跑腿，需要額外花費的事項會停下來打電話請示你，而且你中途叫停其中一人，其他人依然會照常把各自手上的工作辦完。⟧現在只要替 `WebSearch` 與 `WebFetch`（負責搜尋與抓取網頁的工具）設定了詢問規則，它們一定會先跳出確認提示，不再擅自直接連網。當多個工具同時平行執行時，中途取消其中一項工具呼叫，其他平行呼叫所啟動的指令也不會跟著一起被殺掉。
body.en: When letting AI search the web or run multiple actions simultaneously, your control over the underlying tools is now much firmer. ⟦Imagine sending several assistants on separate errands: any task requiring extra expenses pauses to call you for approval, and stopping one assistant midway leaves the others to finish their respective jobs as usual.⟧ Now, whenever you set prompt rules for `WebSearch` and `WebFetch`, they always show a confirmation prompt first instead of accessing the internet on their own. When multiple tools run in parallel, canceling one tool call midway will not kill the commands spawned by other parallel calls.

items.original:
Ask rules for `WebSearch` and `WebFetch` show a prompt instead of running on their own
Cancelling one tool call no longer kills commands started by other parallel calls

title.zh-TW: 登入後不再自動重試指令，遭拒絕的提示詞需手動重發
title.en: Commands no longer auto-retry after login, leaving rejected prompts to be resent manually

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入問題卻因為尚未登入而被擋下時，完成驗證後的下一步現在完全交由你決定。以前只要碰上需要登入的限制，被拒絕的提示詞（prompt，向 AI 發出的指令）在登入完成後常會自動重試。現在登入成功後它不會再擅自重新發送，只會把被擋下的登入區塊留著，需要你手動再次送出。⟦跟在辦公大樓換證一樣，剛才因為沒證件被保全擋下的人，換好證件後櫃檯不會擅自把你推進電梯，而是讓你確認好目的地後再自行前往。⟧
body.en: When a question entered in the terminal is blocked because you are not logged in, the next step after completing authentication is now entirely up to you. Previously, whenever you hit a login requirement, rejected prompts often retried automatically once authentication finished. Now, it no longer resends anything automatically after a successful login; instead, it retains the blocked login prompt block, requiring you to submit it again manually. ⟦Security badge exchanges at an office building follow the same logic: after someone stopped by security for lack of ID gets their visitor badge, the front desk does not shove them into an elevator, but lets them confirm their destination and head up on their own.⟧

items.original: After login, a refused prompt is not retried on its own; the sign-in block needs a manual resend
